text.en: Bela lives with her parents, two brothers Banku and little Bishu, her grandparents and a dog named Shiru. They all play together in the garden.

Namaste! Welcome to Bela's home. Bela has two brothers, Banku Bhaiya and little Bishu.
They live with their father and mother and also their grandmother, whom they call Dadiji, and grandfather, Dadaji.
Shiru the dog is also a member of the family. He has a special place in the home.
We call our relatives by special names. Mother's sister is Mausi, father's sister is Atya, mother's brother is Mama.
Write the names of your family members and what you call them in a table.
Families share work, play, stories and songs. Dadaji teaches the children games he played when he was small.
When it rains the family sits in the garden and sings a rain song while Dadiji makes hot pakodas.
